title_en: Prosecutors search the registered address of Pear S.R.L.
title_es: La Fiscalía allana el domicilio fiscal de Pear S.R.L.
detail_en: On Sat 21 Nov prosecutors Christian Benítez Cáceres and Laura Giacummo (Unidad Especializada de Delitos Económicos y Anticorrupción), with police, searched the premises in Fernando de la Mora that are still registered (Abogacía del Tesoro / Dirección de Personas y Estructuras Jurídicas y Beneficiarios Finales) as the fiscal domicile of Pear S.R.L. The site is now occupied by agricultural-tools importer Herratec S.A.; Pear no longer operates there. Documents on cession of rights/shares and property transfers, described by Benítez as 'relevantes', were handed over and secured for analysis of the 2023 purchase of the 1,184 ha María Antonia (Paraguarí) property from Financiera Ueno (~US$3M).
detail_es: La Fiscalía allana el domicilio fiscal de Pear S.R.L.. (Detalle completo solo en inglés.)

detail_en: Peña's defence lawyer Ricardo Preda Del Puerto filed a note to judge Osmar Legal complaining that, per Servicio de Justicia Militar Nota 349 (18 Nov), Peña may spend only 4 hours a day outside his cell at Viñas Cué while other inmates are out 07:00–19:00 (and must now be isolated during his recreation); he says the transfer was ordered in 18 minutes without inspecting the REP site, worsens the conditions set in A.I. 360 (7 Nov) and 'desnaturaliza' preventive detention, and asks the court to end the 'arbitrariedad' and the damage to Peña's psychological integrity. No court response found yet.

title_en: Executive bill would put Ueno-linked companies under temporary administration for 8 months
title_es: Proyecto del Ejecutivo pondría a las empresas vinculadas a Ueno bajo administración temporal por 8 meses
detail_en: Executive bill (Mensaje N.º 432, received by the Senate 13 Nov; formal entry 18 Nov session; sent to four committees) would place companies linked to ueno bank — same economic group or declared related by ownership/management, including firms that left the group in the prior 12 months via transfers to insiders/relatives — automatically under an 8-month temporary-administration regime. A Consejo de Supervisión de Sociedades Vinculadas under the MIC (chaired by the Presidency; MIC, MEF, MTESS; BCP with voice but no vote) would identify firms, appoint/remove administrators, authorise asset/unit sales and report possible crimes to prosecutors; non-viable firms can be excluded.

title_en: BCP: deposits above the guarantee cap depend on the sale of asset lots to other banks

detail_en: Hoy, citing the BCP: depositors above the FGD cap (G. 228.3M) depend on the 'balance de exclusión' — interveners are reclassifying assets (loan quality 1–3, real estate, vehicles) into lots (e.g., G. 60/80/100M) to auction to other banks; if the sale succeeds deposits are transferred in full, including above 75 minimum wages and public/pension funds; otherwise the FGD pays the remaining 35 minimum wages up to the cap.
